sources.title: The Cost of Cloud LLM APIs vs Local Inference: A TCO Analysis
sources.snippet: A detailed total cost of ownership analysis comparing cloud LLM APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google against local inference. With real pricing data and three deployment scenarios, we show when local inference costs 5-20x less — and how to make the switch.
